propositions: The Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails consistently when .bridge_state/projects.json contains nonexistent Jira project keys (LEG, ONE, TWO, ZERO) from a rehearsal fixture that was committed to the live tickets branch

The fetcher._build_snapshot fan-out generates JQL queries for every key in projects.json; a query with a nonexistent project key is syntactically valid but rejected by Jira, causing ACLI to exit 1 and the reconcile pass to fail

The live tickets branch projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal mapping via ad-hoc git commits (test-fixture identity) at 2026-08-14T19:18-0700, 21 minutes before the first consistent failure at 2026-08-15T02:39Z

The canonical known-good state of projects.json is {"version": 1, "legacy_default": "REB", "projects": {}} with an empty projects dict, which causes the fan-out to fall back to a single configured project (REB)
Bridge-state writes lack the unified store write lock, commit, and push semantics required by the concurrency invariant, enabling ad-hoc hand-commits that corrupted the live branch
